title: Three things I would tell myself before strength training at 35
caption: Strength training for beginners over 35: three things I would tell myself on day one. Ten minutes counts, start at the wall, and keep the same few moves. Save this and start at the wall.

overlays.text: Three things I would tell myself before I started strength training at 35.

scenes.footer: The free hour was never coming.

overlays.text: Ten minutes counts as a full session. It is not a warm-up for later.

scenes.footer: The floor comes later. You will get there.

overlays.text: Start at the wall, not the floor. Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Lower slow, press away.

scenes.footer: Repeating them is how you get stronger.

overlays.text: The same few moves every day beat a new plan every Monday.

scenes.footer: Push, squat, hinge. Two rounds, about ten minutes.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up, 10 reps. Sit-to-Stand, 8 reps. Glute Bridge, 10 reps.

scenes.footer: Save this and start at the wall.
